relations: The front leg lifting into a forward extension causes the torso to lean and head to tilt.
The mirror on the left reflects the changing posture during the leg extension and lowering.
The back leg supporting the weight enables the front leg to rise off the floor and return.
caption: The video captures a woman in a dance studio practicing a controlled leg extension. She stands in profile facing left, wearing a mauve long-sleeve top and dark wide-leg trousers, with a small white flower prop held at her hip. A full-height mirror wall on the left reproduces her posture as a reflection, while sheer-curtained windows, ballet barres, and a potted plant anchor the right side of the room. The camera and background remain fixed as the movement continues. Her front foot rests on the floor while the back leg supports her weight. The front leg then rises into a forward extension held off the ground before lowering back to a placed position. After a grounded interval, the same leg again lifts into a pointed forward extension, which remains held. Her torso leans and her head tilts gently in coordination with each movement.
